banner.text: Fableris is now available on Android!

news.title: The Paperclip Factory — community story by Cyril
news.text: One AI, one badly worded goal, and an escalation as logical as it is dizzying. Discover Cyril's fable, featured in the Community tab — and join the contest for the next publication!

news.title: New free stories and the Cosmos Pack
news.text: Guardians of Harmony and The Light Afraid of the Dark (kids) are available! The Cosmos Pack DLC offers Signal Rouge — an investigation aboard station Aletheia-9.

news.title: Discover The Station of Regrets by William
news.text: Our first featured community story! A journey between worlds, written by William. Want to be next? Join the contest from the Community tab.

news.title: Welcome to Fableris
news.text: Fableris is officially launched! Free stories await you, with unique universes and dozens of different endings. Have a great adventure.

news.title: Many free stories available
news.text: Project Lazarus, The Theatre of Carcosa, The Butcher's Dreams, The Last Minutes, The Last Round and The Station of Regrets, and more! — all free, all playable right now.

news.title: StoryForge — Create your stories
news.text: The StoryForge visual editor is available for everyone. Create your own interactive story, test it, and submit it for official publication.

news.title: Fableris is in a 14-day testing phase
